edge.title: Customer side
edge.summary: What customers touch: the public site.

services.title: Core logic
services.summary: The store's own logic: ordering and fulfilment.

data.title: Stored state
data.summary: Where state lives: the task buffer and the order store.

external.title: Partners
external.summary: Providers the store depends on but does not run.

web.title: Customer site
web.summary: Serves pages to customers and passes each request inward.

api.title: Order service
api.summary: Takes orders, asks the card processor to charge, and schedules fulfilment tasks.

queue.title: Task buffer
queue.summary: Holds pending tasks between ordering and fulfilment.

worker.title: Fulfiller
worker.summary: Picks up tasks, completes them and records the outcome.

db.title: Order store
db.summary: Keeps every order and its progress.

payments.title: Card processor
payments.summary: A third-party service that charges cards. It is not run here.

shop-http.title: Site calls
shop-http.summary: The requests the customer site sends inward.

job-message.title: Task record
job-message.summary: The fields of a fulfilment task: order number, kind and attempt number.

orders-schema.title: Order records
orders-schema.summary: The order tables that ordering and fulfilment read and write.

charge-api.title: Charge call
charge-api.summary: The processor's charge endpoint, documented by the processor; not wired yet.

web-to-api.trigger: A customer opens a page or places an order.

api-to-queue.trigger: An order is saved and needs fulfilling.

queue-to-worker.trigger: A task is waiting and a fulfiller is free.

worker-to-db.trigger: A task finishes and its outcome is stored.

api-to-db.trigger: An order is created or read.

api-to-payments.trigger: Checkout asks the processor to charge a card.

worker-heartbeat.trigger: Every minute the fulfiller reports that it is alive.
